notes.title: Developer Update!
notes.content: [p]Kuroki Yume games has been quite silent for a while now. To be frank I had taken a short break but I have been recently working on a new project...[/p][p][/p][p]Currently codenamed "cabin" the new horror game is about 30% complete! Here are some in progress screenshots[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139410/d4aac1afb536c194ea3f8768098669e61733675f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139410/92fda0602d6038088d24032c51db5b49a58c8778.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139410/7cd9e8d1f4eb81fd00b8955e4500ccd408d8563d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139410/2ab7a858a77a159f2f05d67eddf000f64a8ca11c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for taking the time to read it! As promised your reward will be some keys to my other game "Tenshi" as well as some keys for "the Yamamura Estate". notes.title: 日本語版がリリースされた！
notes.content: このゲームは日本でも人気があるので、私はあなたの言語に翻訳するためにベストを尽くすことにした！完璧ではないかもしれませんが、ご容赦ください！応援ありがとうございました

notes.title: Bug fixes/Performance Fix
notes.content:
Performance should be significantly improved:
-Changed LODs
-Changed Light processing

Bug Fixes:
-Candle in first level fixed
-Auto save softlock fix
-Clipping/getting stuck or outside of the map fix

notes.title: Animation Update
notes.content:
- Sadako now has new animation and static effect removed
- Easter eggs added ;)

notes.title: Footstep audio fix
notes.content: Footsteps throughout the game will now match the surface being walked on
